summary.name: Macaify
summary.one_liner: Macaify is a macOS app that brings AI assistance into any Mac app via a select-then-shortcut workflow, plus a standard chat mode.
keywords: rewrite text with ai on mac
use_cases: Translate or polish selected text in any Mac app
Use ChatGPT or Claude without switching apps
Chat with AI using selected content as pinned context
Use your own OpenAI or Anthropic API key on macOS
summary.what_it_does: Macaify lets you select text in any Mac app, press a shortcut, and get AI output in place, which the developer calls In Context Mode. It also offers a conventional chat mode where selected content stays pinned at the top as discussion context. The Free plan includes custom models via bring-your-own-API-key (BYOK), with providers named including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta. Pro and Pro+ tiers add Macaify AI+ and advanced models from providers such as Google, Perplexity, and xAI. The page says the code is on GitHub and the app is open source and free.
notable: In Context Mode: select text, press a shortcut, get AI results in the same app
Open source with code on GitHub
Listed in awesome-mac as a freeware productivity tool
caveats: Pro and Pro+ are paid tiers that unlock Macaify AI+ and advanced models
Free plan uses some models; the page does not list which ones beyond named providers
